title: Send a dashboard invitation with only non-access groups selected
steps: Inspect the collection permissions, close that view, and open Campaign Performance.
Open Share and choose Invite someone to view this.
Enter the invitee email, open Groups, and select Marketing.
Close the picker and inspect the access warning.
Reopen Groups and add Sales, then inspect the selected memberships and warning state.
Remove Sales, leaving Marketing and the mandatory All Users group selected, and inspect the access warning again.
Send the invitation and verify that it succeeds.

video_guide.summary: Watch the warning directly below Groups: it appears for Marketing, clears when Sales is added, and returns when Sales is removed. The warning still allows the invitation to be sent.

chapters.note: Permissions establish the setup: Marketing and All Users have No access; Sales has View access.
The Groups picker separates Can view this dashboard from Other groups.
Only Marketing and All Users are selected. The yellow warning below Groups says the invitee cannot view this dashboard.
Sales and Marketing remain selected together; no access warning is visible.
Only Marketing and All Users remain selected; the yellow access warning is visible and Send invitation retains its enabled appearance.
The invitation dialog is closed and Invitation sent is visible at the bottom left.
